parent_objective: implement no-training closed-loop replay admission for M689 residual heads

public_gates: replay implementation reconstructs source-heldout rows or reports reconstruction failure
base and residual-corrected variants are compared
wrong-history or boundary-risk utility metrics are reported
no base actor checkpoint is written
no training or PPO is used
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train the residual head
do not write a base actor checkpoint
do not promote M689 residual heads
do not change actor observation inputs
do not replace replay evidence with exact output metrics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_rollout: residual-head action correction must show trajectory-level utility before actor update
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the no-training closed-loop replay admission gate designed in M691
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: replay admission result only, not actor update, PPO, or promotion
stop_condition: stop this branch if replay rows cannot be reconstructed from current artifacts
stop before actor update or PPO unless replay admission is replay_positive
stop or synthesize if replay is neutral after normal retention holds
fallback_plan: if reconstruction fails, design an offline trajectory-consistency audit
if normal regression occurs, return to first-action trust-region residual design
if replay is neutral, run branch synthesis before another residual-head objective
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after M692 audit if replay is neutral or before any actor-update design

hypothesis: M689 residual-head corrections can be replayed in short closed-loop continuations without normal-history regression and with measurable wrong-history or boundary-risk utility.
success_criteria: wrong-history or boundary-risk utility metrics are finite
result is classified as replay_positive, replay_neutral, normal_regression, or surface_reconstruction_failure
failure_criteria: implementation trains actor or residual head
implementation writes a base actor checkpoint
implementation omits wrong-history or boundary-risk utility metrics

commands.name: replay_admission
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.gate_margin_replay_admission --checkpoint runs/m568_scaled_l3_bc_seed5660/checkpoint.pt --shadow-corpus runs/m671_response_amplification_shadow/shadow_corpus.npz --metadata runs/m671_response_amplification_shadow/shadow_metadata.csv --residual-head runs/m689_gate_margin_response_amplification/seed_6890/residual_sequence_head.pt --residual-head runs/m689_gate_margin_response_amplification/seed_6891/residual_sequence_head.pt --residual-head runs/m689_gate_margin_response_amplification/seed_6892/residual_sequence_head.pt --alpha 1.0 --surface-config fresh=configs/ppo_m541_matched_l3_variance_4096.json --surface-config ood=configs/eval_m574_moderate_ood_l3.json --max-source-heldout-rows 120 --max-continuation-steps 40 --max-first-action-l2 0.006 --min-wrong-risk-improvement 0.01 --max-normal-margin-regression 0.005 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m692_gate_margin_closed_loop_replay

decision_rule: M692 passes as implementation if it writes replay artifacts without training or promotion; only replay_positive can admit a later actor-update design.
